case_ids.0: 두 자료 모두 유효(둘 다 맞음)
case_ids.source: GTJUDGE scenes/<stem>/stage1_cells.npz case_id (stage-1 normal-line cells, tau=1)

scoring.completeness: GTJUDGE stage-1 normal-line distance (normal_line.measure: 5 rays at 0/±0.05 m tangent shifts, both directions, limit roof 10 m / wall 5 m); within = |s| <= row tau (reference__<method>__within_tau1 from unrounded distance)
scoring.accuracy: addendum 11/12 normal_cylinder_1m rule (eligible_new & within_tau1 / eligible_new). This is the rule that gives the order 0.1 table values 65.3/77.7; the 'addendum 2 3.4' wording is not present in the GTJUDGE configs, the old euclidean_1m rule is recounted alongside
scoring.new_meshes: unchanged GTJUDGE score_new + addendum11 rule (as TRAINLOG tl_mesh.score); scorer validated by re-scoring the stored A1 meshes before use
scoring.tau: docs/experiments/phd/main_release_v1/tables/stage0/tau_values.csv (B0 LoD2 roof 0.27176 / wall 0.64250 m; R1 ALS 0.13225 m all)

point_sets.c1_c2_lost: reference rows with case_id==cell case, target-surface within_tau1==1 and trained within_tau1==0 (far hit or no surface)
point_sets.c3_lost: trained-mesh result samples with case_id==4, eligible_new==1, within_tau1==0, and target-surface distance > tau. Target-surface distance = normal_line.measure from the result point along its stored (reference-aligned) normal against the target-surface mesh; no hit within roof 10 / wall 5 m counts as > tau
point_sets.patch_of_point: column patch = GTJUDGE rows.npz row_owner (JUDGEAPPLY core point index) -> core_points.source_index -> target-file row; result samples use the stored sample column owner

visibility.views: all real training views of the site (GTJUDGE views/<site>.json, K/W2C/size)
visibility.pixel: floor(K X / z + 0.5), the jbgs_gtjudge.candidate_mask convention
visibility.reference_points_c1_c2: GT mesh is not in the repository (GT is used as a point cloud, GT_triangulated=False). Substitute: per view z-buffer of the GTJUDGE reference dense points (minimum camera z per nearest pixel). A point is seen when inside the image, z>0 and z_point - zbuffer <= 0.05 m
visibility.result_points_c3: trained (result) mesh ray cast from the camera centre; seen when first hit >= |X - C| - 0.05 m
visibility.facing_group: angle between point-to-camera direction and the reference normal (c3: stored reference-aligned result normal) <= 30 deg; else oblique

check1.1-마: stored state==1 (no trained-mesh hit within roof 10 / wall 5 m)
check1.1-나: closest-point (unsigned) distance from the point to the trained mesh <= tau while |s| > tau
check1.1-다: first hit X = p + shift(offset id) + s n is within tau of a reference dense point q that is not on the point's own surface: |n_p.(q - p)| > tau
check1.c3_1-나: nearest reference dense point within tau while the normal_cylinder_1m distance is > tau or missing
check1.tau_multiplier_cells: cells fixed at tau=1 (GTJUDGE 가 rule), scoring threshold multiplied

check2.applies: c1, c2: lost points forwarded by check 1 and all control points
check2.2-가: row_owner < 0, or the column target row is not a valid patch of the arm's target file (r6 valid_patch: region>=0, finite target/normal, finite sigma>0)
check2.2-나: |t| > tau, t = ray parameter from p along n_p to the patch target plane (target point, patch normal); |n_patch.n_p| < 1e-6 counts as > tau
check2.2-다: seen views whose target-map owner at the point's pixel equals the column target row < 3. Maps = the exact stored maps the arm trained with (stage1/<stem>/maps, sha checked; owner = frontmost patch disc row index)
check2.2-마: more than half of the views counted in 2-다 have weight <= 0.1 + 1e-6 (floor 0.1)
check2.extra: distributions of seen views, owner-matching views and weights for lost and control points

check3.drawer: PROCFIG/TRAINLOG lineage: for each seen view the max alpha*T Gaussian at the point's pixel from the TARGET r5 maxid rasterizer on the arm's 30000 model (point_cloud/iteration_30000/point_cloud.ply), modal over seen views, ties lowest index; per-Gaussian tag/index/origin from target_monitor/snapshot_30000.npz (row order checked against the PLY)
check3.3-마: no seen view, no drawer, or the modal Gaussian count < half of the seen views
check3.3-가: drawer target_tag==1 and its bound patch (valid_patch[target_index]) is the column target row
check3.3-나: drawer target_tag==1 bound to another patch
check3.3-다: drawer origin==1 (patch seed lineage) and target_tag!=1
check3.applies_1ra: c1/c2 1-라 points, all c3 lost points, all control points
check3.3-바: at 30000 some Gaussian with target_tag==1 bound to the column target row has |n_p.(x - p)| <= tau
check3.applies_empty: c1/c2 1-다 and 1-마 points (control points get the same test)
check3.3-가_detail: h = n_patch.(x - target), width = 1.96 sigma_patch; '원반 기울기' when |n_p.(x - p)| <= tau, else '구간 안 τ 밖'

page50.note: check_cause_range.py is not in the repository, payloads or this host; recount with the definition below
page50.surface_point: c1/c2: trained first hit X (points with a hit); c3: the result point
page50.population: lost points beyond tau with a surface vs control points

check4.applies: c1/c2 1-라 and 3-바 points, all c3 lost points; control points get the same per-view test
check4.per_view: render depth D (2DGS surf_depth, camera z) of the arm's 30000 model at the point's exact projection; X_v = back-projection of the exact (u,v) at depth D; d = n.(X_v - p). |d|<=tau 맞음, else 틀림; render alpha < 0.5 빔
check4.c3_meaning: 맞음 = render depth reproduces the result point (|n_r.(X_v - p_r)| <= tau)
check4.4-라: more than half of the seen views 빔
check4.4-나: both groups have >= 2 non-empty views and the group majorities (맞음 vs 틀림, ties = no majority) are both defined and differ
check4.4-가: c1/c2: more than half of the seen views 맞음 (mesh is wrong by construction); c3: more than half do not reproduce the result point
check4.4-다: c1/c2: more than half 틀림; c3: more than half reproduce the result point
check4.four_depths: same ray: reference depth (c1/c2 the point z; c3 the reference z-buffer), target-map depth, render depth, trained-mesh first hit (ray cast, camera z)
check4.renderer_check: maxid render depth compared with the speed renderer depth at the sampled pixels; differences recorded

cross_tables.unit: points and percent of all lost points of the cell x arm

culprit.share_denominator: all lost points of the cell x arm (control: all control points)

region.union: boxes snapped outward to a 0.25 m voxel grid; inside = voxel lookup (exact union of the snapped boxes)

record_runs.switches: --jbgs_trainlog on --jbgs_trainlog_region <region file> --jbgs_trainlog_grads on, seed 0, 30000 iterations, otherwise the original command
record_runs.save_iterations: TRAINLOG 2.2: 0..3000 every 100, 3000..15000 every 500, 15000..30000 every 2500, plus states just before each opacity reset (3000, 6000, 9000, 12000)
record_runs.key_extra: 3000_pre_reset scene state and mesh (TRAINLOG: the end-of-iteration 3000 state is right after the opacity reset)
record_runs.gradients: at every save iteration, before total_loss.backward(): torch.autograd.grad(term, [_xyz, _opacity], retain_graph=True, allow_unused=True) for photo = rgb_loss, depth = depth_lambda * target depth loss, gs2d = dist_loss + normal_loss (the terms as added to the total loss); record per in-range Gaussian uid, |dL/dxyz| and |dL/dopacity_logit|
record_runs.key_mesh_scoring: 30000: full scorer; other key iterations: normal-line measure of the record-run lost and control points only

check5.lost: redefined on the record run 30000 mesh with the same point-set rule; drawers found with the check-3 method on the record 30000 model
check5.applies: unique drawer Gaussians of 3-나, 3-다, 3-라 points (also reported point-weighted)
check5.5-가: at 30000 target_tag==1 bound to a patch other than the point's column patch and |n_q.(x - target_q)| <= tau
check5.5-나: record 30000 mesh in the region split into pieces (faces sharing a vertex after merging vertices closer than 0.1 m, dihedral angle <= 30 deg); the piece of the face closest to the Gaussian centre has >= 30 % of its area (face centroids) within tau of a reference dense point not on the lost point's surface (|n_p.(q-p)| > tau)
check5.5-다: |x_30000 - x_birth| <= tau; birth = state 0 position (initial) or the birth event position (clone/split; parent birth position also recorded); birth outside the range = 확인 불가
check5.5-라: moved > tau, closest-point distance from x_30000 to the AXES71 MVS mesh (main_axes71_v2 mvs/<site>/mesh_mvs_a.ply) <= tau, and summed |dL/dxyz| over saved iterations from birth to the first saved iteration within tau of the final position: photo > depth
check5.empty_points: 3-사 points: Gaussians bound to the column patch at any saved state; fate from events: 5-바 delete (by reason), 5-사 release then inside the range at 30000 (cell and normal height difference recorded), 5-아 left the range; point class = modal fate (ties 바, 사, 아); none found = 확인 불가
check5.curves: key-iteration meshes: share of record-run lost points within tau; culprit-population counts per saved state

populations.3-나: target_tag==1 and bound patch != column patch at the Gaussian centre
populations.3-가: target_tag==1 and bound patch == column patch at the Gaussian centre

check6.opacity_zero: the Gaussians are removed from the rendered model (identical to opacity 0)
check6.mesh: all training views re-rendered, unchanged GTJUDGE/RESCORE mesh recipe, full scorer
check6.recovery: (after - trained) / (target - trained) on the cell value; lost-point recovery (share of lost points within tau after) reported alongside
check6.control_loss_pp: c1/c2: drop of control points within tau; c3: share of control result-point locations without a new-mesh surface within tau
check6.view_groups: 4-나 >= 50 %: facing-only and oblique-only meshes with views grouped by the dominant group of the lost points that see them; 4-가 >= 50 %: drop views that are 틀림 for the majority of 4-가 points that see them

confirm_training.select: per scene x arm the culprit with the largest simulation recovery >= 20 %
confirm_training.name: cf_<site>_<prior>_<own|gt>_<bindbg|rebind|reassign>_s0

classes.6-가: recovery >= 50 % and control loss <= 2 pp and scene accuracy loss <= 2 pp

intervention_switches.default: off for all three; with all off r28 makes the r23 decisions (with --jbgs_targets the r25 decisions)
intervention_switches.--jbgs_bind_background: at every periodic 100-step check, after the inherited reattach: unbound Gaussians with origin==0 (target_tag==0) that meet the reattach rule (TargetR7.candidates: tangent <= 0.5 m from a patch anchor and normal excess beyond 1.96 sigma <= 0.5 m) get target_tag=1 and that patch, then the inherited project_bounds
intervention_switches.--jbgs_reassign_same: in every reattach, candidate patches of a bound Gaussian are limited to patches with the same patch_region as its current patch and |n_cur.(anchor_new - anchor_cur)| <= 1.96 sigma_cur; no candidate = released

fork.merged: r25 --jbgs_targets / --jbgs_preserve_freespace (jbgs_gtjudge.py, target_path, verify_override, prune opacity mask hook)

unit_checks.replay: TRAINLOG replay_test.py adapted: real complete state at iteration 200 of a small-example probe, deterministic synthetic loss, inherited controller and density control for 300 iterations; byte comparison of model, Adam, density statistics, target metadata, controller events, RNG
unit_checks.default: r23 FinalTrain vs r28 (all switches off) on own targets: byte-identical replay
unit_checks.gt_targets: r25 vs r28 with --jbgs_targets on gt targets: byte-identical replay
unit_checks.record_invariance: r28 off vs r28 trainlog + region + gradients on: byte-identical replay; plus the TRAINLOG alternative real-run test with two runs each (cross-pair median <= same-setting maximum, 300 iterations, densification from 100, opacity reset 200)
unit_checks.numbers_events: TRAINLOG probe_check: parent uid, no uid reuse, unique uids per state, (after) = (before) + born - deleted + in - out
unit_checks.switches: each switch on vs off for one periodic reattach on the replay state: only Gaussians of its defined set change tag/index/position; all others byte-identical

figures.rule: one script for all cells and arms, same colours and legends, no text except cell name, axes, legend; json provenance per figure

execution.retry: one retry with the same settings on error/OOM, then 결과 없음
execution.gpu_check: nvidia-smi before each GPU job; never stop other GPU processes
execution.long_jobs: nohup/background, checks only at end and 7000 health

reading_appendix_verbatim: 그 칸의 하락은 주로 채점 문턱과 방식 탓이다. 개선 대상이 아니라 원고에서 τ 민감도와 함께 적는다
'떠 있는 면'이 아니라 '위 물체 아래를 비운 것'으로 고쳐 부른다
판정은 맞았지만 목표가 없거나 틀렸다. 목표 만들기를 고친다
앞 패치 목표가 가려 그 점의 목표가 학습에 들어가지 않았다. 목표 깊이 지도 규칙을 고친다
영상으로 관측되지 않는 자리다. 범위·한계로 적는다
목표는 들어갔으나 무게가 약하다. 정밀도 무게를 본다
'판정이 맞은 곳의 틀린 면은 ○○ 가우시안이 그린다'(배율과 함께)
원인이 한 무리로 모이지 않는다. 분류별 비율을 그대로 적는다
표면 추출 단계의 문제다. 학습 쪽 고침보다 추출 쪽을 먼저 본다(메시 규칙을 바꿀지는 사용자 결정)
특정 시점에서만 앞을 덮는 가우시안이 생긴다. 그 시점 묶음의 학습을 본다
가: 재할당 조건, 나: 가장자리 처리, 다: 초기화와 밀도 제어, 라: 광도와 깊이 무게를 고칠 곳으로 본다
원인 확인. 그 개입을 개선 설계의 출발점으로 쓴다
원인이지만 무리 전체를 바꾸면 맞는 면도 해친다. 무리 안에서 고르는 규칙이 필요하다
원인이 더 있거나 다른 곳이다. 교차표의 다음 칸을 본다
reading_appendix_use: 분석 세션용. 이 작업은 쓰지 않는다(분류와 숫자만 낸다)
